description: A full bot match runs without errors: freeze, live, end, next round, match end at 13 rounds, score reset.
acceptance: Headless match of 10 min shows rounds advancing, correct winner per round, no exceptions in log, match restarts after 13 wins.
test: Run headless match 10 min; parse REPORT lines; grep Exception.
evidence: 2026-11-24: 4 min headless match, 7 rounds, score 6:1, 0 exceptions. 13-round end not yet observed.

description: Bots move, take cover, fight both teams fairly; attackers carry and plant the bomb; defenders defuse.
acceptance: In 10 headless rounds: bomb planted in >=3 rounds, at least one defuse, win rate per team between 30% and 70%.
test: Headless match with counters for plants/defuses/wins per team.

description: Round never ends prematurely or with a wrong winner (time-out = defenders win; bomb exploded = attackers; defused = defenders; elimination).
acceptance: Unit-style play test of each end condition logged with expected winner.
test: Scripted test scenarios in a test scene.

description: Economy: start money, kill rewards by weapon, win/loss income, max money, buy time and buy menu restrictions.
acceptance: Money values in logs follow the table for 5 rounds.

description: Damage model: head/body multipliers, armour, distance falloff, wall penetration none, friendly fire off.
acceptance: Automated test fires at dummies and checks HP results.

description: Touch controls: movement stick, look, fire, jump, crouch, reload, switch, scope, use, buy; responsive (<1 frame input latency in code), multi-touch safe.
acceptance: Manual test on phone by owner + automated input simulation in play mode.

description: Look sensitivity, invert, button layout size and FOV are saved and restored between sessions.
acceptance: Change settings, restart app, values persist.

description: First-person view: weapon at lower right, barrel forward, both hands on the weapon, correct for knife, pistols, rifles, sniper.
acceptance: Proof sheet of all prepared weapons idle/fire/reload/switch reviewed and approved; no clipping into camera.

description: First-person reload, switch, fire recoil, sprint and idle sway animations.
acceptance: Proof sheet frames for each phase; plays in game screenshots.

description: Third-person: 4 characters animate idle/walk/run/crouch/jump/fire/reload/death with hands locked on the weapon.
acceptance: Proof sheets for all 4 characters reviewed; no floating hands; feet not below ground >2 cm.
evidence: Sheets a_states_ak, b_hold_* reviewed 2026-11-24; reload pose rifle points up; feet dip up to 3.5 cm.

description: Deaths do not slide through walls; body stays where it fell.
acceptance: In-game test: kill next to wall, body does not penetrate.

description: All 24 weapons have their own models with grip markers (no stand-ins).
acceptance: Every Weapons.All key has Resources/Weapons/<key>.prefab with GripR/GripL/Muzzle.
evidence: 5 of 24 prepared (knife, usp, deagle, ak, awp).

description: Muzzle flash, tracer from the real muzzle, shell ejection, impact decals per surface.
acceptance: In-game screenshots while firing.

description: Real recorded sounds for shots per weapon family, reload, footsteps, impacts, voices, bomb; spatialised 3D audio.
acceptance: All sounds load (no silent events in log); credits complete.
test: Headless check that every Fx.Sound name resolves to a clip.
evidence: 73 recordings + credits; resolution check not automated yet.

description: Audio mixer: master/sfx/voice/ui volumes in settings, footsteps of enemies audible, distance attenuation tuned.
acceptance: Settings change volumes; values saved.

description: Level is large enough for 5v5 (two or three lanes, one bomb site, rotations) with no holes, no void visible, no stuck spots.
acceptance: Nav-mesh reaches all intended areas; bots never stuck >5 s in a 10-min match; screenshot review of all areas.

description: Tajik architecture identity: ornamented carved wooden doors and columns (Pamiri/ Khujand style), painted ceilings in an aivan, ornament tiles, bazaar stalls, mountains backdrop.
acceptance: Screenshot review: at least 6 distinct Tajik features visible.

description: Graffiti SAFARZOD and '11 A БА ПЕШ.' clearly readable.
acceptance: Screenshot from 8 m readable.

description: Phone-ready rendering: quality presets Low/Medium/High; shadows, SSAO, post-processing per preset; LOD groups; texture sizes capped.
acceptance: 3 presets switch at runtime; settings saved; triangle count per frame < 300k on High.

description: Lighting: baked or probe-based ambient, reflection probes, sun matching sky, contact shadows via SSAO.
acceptance: Screenshot review.

description: Stable 60 FPS on a mid-range phone (target: Snapdragon 7-series / Mali-G68 class) on Medium preset; 30 FPS on Low-end on Low.
acceptance: On-device FPS overlay readings reported by owner; CPU main-thread time measured in headless run <8 ms.

description: Character models <= 15k triangles each with LODs; draw calls < 250 on Medium.
acceptance: Editor report of mesh stats.

description: Designed main menu with play vs bots, LAN host/join, settings, credits; consistent typography and palette.
acceptance: Screenshots at 16:9, 19.5:9 and 4:3 reviewed.

description: Settings screens: graphics, controls, sound; saved.
acceptance: Change, restart, persisted.

description: HUD: health, armour, ammo, money, timer, score, kill feed, crosshair, hit marker, bomb indicator; readable on phone.
acceptance: Screenshot review on 2 resolutions.

description: Loading screen, pause menu, scoreboard (hold button), match end screen with MVP.
acceptance: Screenshots of each.

description: LAN play: host + client join by discovery or IP; both see each other move, shoot, die; rounds sync.
acceptance: Two Linux players on one machine run a match; client REPORT shows same score as host.

description: Zero errors/exceptions in logs during a 10-minute match.
acceptance: grep counts 0.

description: ASSET_LICENSES.md lists every third-party asset with author, licence, URL; no NC/ND assets.
acceptance: Script compares Assets folders against the list.
